feat: initial bluesky bot with placeholder responses

- Set up FastAPI web framework with async lifespan management
- Implement AT Protocol client for Bluesky authentication and API calls
- Create notification polling system that checks for mentions every 10 seconds
- Add placeholder response generator with random bot messages
- Implement proper notification marking using Void's timestamp approach
- Add graceful shutdown handling for hot reloading
- Create test scripts for posting and mentions
- Set up project structure with modular services
- Add comprehensive sandbox documentation from reference projects
- Configure development environment with uv, ruff, and ty

The bot can now:
- Authenticate with Bluesky using app password
- Poll for mentions and respond with placeholder messages
- Properly mark notifications as read without duplicates
- Handle graceful shutdown during development

Ready for LLM integration and memory system implementation.

🤖 Generated with Claude Code

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

Watch fastmcp triage throughput for the operator

The operator maintains PrefectHQ/fastmcp, where open PRs went from 47 to 198
in eight weeks. my-prefect-server now syncs every issue and PR into its
warehouse and models intake against merges, how long contributors wait for
a maintainer, and the PRs stuck longest; the hub serves it at
/api/agents/fastmcp-triage.

- inspect_fastmcp_triage reads that endpoint on demand and renders it with
  the definitions that keep comparisons honest: bots don't count as
  maintainers, merges not closures, and the triage-reviewed split is not
  causal.
- fastmcp-watch is a weekly pass Prefect wakes through the control API, per
  the bot's convention. Phi compares against her earlier notes and reports
  privately only when something changed; a quiet week needs no message.
- The endpoint is in SERVICE_CHECKS, the tool declares its risk, and
  docs/memory.md lists the new surface.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Resolve context ambiguities identified by Phi after consolidation

mcp_tools: default pdsx reads to phi's repo

pdsx falls back to the x-atproto-repo header when list_records or
get_record get no repo. DeepSeek passed repo=null nine times in one run;
those reads now go to phi's own repo instead of erroring.
